node.title: M31 rank-seven dense top decorated shift-pair router
node.statement: Every forbidden M31 Q=147595 proper-G zero-excess class has more than one tenth of all member pairs at maximal combined intersection 4980. Hence one member has at least 215793 neighbors satisfying the primitive decorated top-stratum identity A C_i-B C_j=c!=0 with deg A=deg B=w+1=67448 and gcd(C_i,C_j)=1. At most 14 neighbors share a projective difference direction, so at least 15414 monic degree-4980 divisors of the anchor support locator lie in the six-dimensional direction space. A local cap 215792 or fixed-support divisor cap 15413 eliminates the terminal.
node.notes: Exact local successor theorem only. It proves the forced lower degree in the primitive decorated top stratum, not the excluding upper cap, an upstream atom, a row closure, or a Prize result.
